channel.title: La Paix du Cœur — News
channel.description: News from La Paix du Cœur: food drives, street outreach, workshops and life in the association.

item.title: Welcome to our new website, in French and English
item.description: A clearer, safer, bilingual website to keep you informed, bring people together and share the mission of Kimia Na Motema.

item.title: Thank you! Looking back on our fall food drive
item.description: One Saturday outside a Montréal grocery store, dozens of full bags and a lot of smiles. Here is what your generosity made possible.

item.title: Winter outreach: getting the thermoses ready
item.description: As the cold arrives, our evening street outreach starts again. Hot coffee, soup, toques and mittens: here is how we organize, and how you can join us.

item.title: Our "budget and self-reliance" workshop: what we learned
item.description: Our training workshops have one simple goal: that everyone leaves more self-reliant. A look back at an afternoon on family budgeting.
